coordinator_scientific_classification.basis: The all-surviving TEST diagnostics show weak row-level agreement between combat expected-outcome ranking and Silver qProduct (Pearson 0.0986, Spearman 0.1712), near-chance macro pairwise concordance (0.5221), and low within-decision rank correlation (0.0541). This classification is scientific coordination from reported diagnostics, not an automatic threshold.
coordinator_scientific_classification.label: TARGET MISMATCH

raw_package.reuse_verification: All 64 combat manifests, semantic manifests/CSVs, and manifest-bound combat CSV hashes validated locally.

gate_protocol.decision_unit: Complete sibling set per (sourceSeed, decisionIdx); no score mixing.
gate_protocol.selection_rule: Among validation gates with mean regret <= 0.005 and p95 regret <= 0.025, maximize actual Silver simulation savings; tie-break by lower margin then lower survival threshold.

notes: TEST was evaluated once after the validation gate was frozen; no TEST-derived gate selection or tuning was performed.

The raw archive and original held-out CSV/manifest were absent locally. The preserved corpus directory and hash-matching frozen model files were reused; predictions were deterministically rematerialized without fitting or label generation.
No runtime gating or gameplay integration was implemented.
Knowledge impact: none; the reusable analyzer routing and current training/inference documentation were already updated in the implementation commits.

predictor_artifacts.metric_reproduction: The rematerialized frozen-model predictions reproduce the recorded §219 train/validation/TEST point metrics exactly.

rematerialized_predictions.verification: rematerialized predictions reproduce the recorded §219 train/validation/TEST point metrics exactly

target_mismatch_diagnostics.outcome_slice_note: Outcome slices require valid actual combat labels for every sibling; groups with invalid labels are omitted.
